$comment: AUTHORED (S12, Spec 69 M-21; claude adjudicates, the operator confirms). The judgment inputs of the one-time legacy-id map built by scripts/analysis/bylaw/legacy.mjs. Everything else in the map is derived from the page. picks: a quote that matches more than one place on a page → the chosen candidate (checked to be one of the matches). relocate: a quote not in the cited article but found elsewhere on the page → the accepted location (checked). retire: a fragment retired with a closed reason (the 12 UNVERIFIED C-claims retire from the source's own result, not from here). external: a claim whose source is not a pinned by-law page → an external.json ref id; proposed_refs are the ref entries S12 proposes for external.json (REF-1..3 landed in external.json 2026-10-07; proposed_refs is kept as the S12 record).

operator_confirmed.ruling: operator 2026-10-07 (S12): the 5 picks, 2 relocations (H19, H20) and 2 C4 retirements are confirmed; REF-1..3 landed in external.json

picks_why.C15@ch10_5: C15 is an NF-12 (front-yard landscaping %) claim; the 60 percent front-yard tier is (1)(C). (2)(A) is the corner side yard (NF-14, C17).
picks_why.C57@ch10_80: C57 records the front-yard setback condition of 10.80.40.70; (1) is the front yard setback. (4)(A)(i)(b) is the townhouse-row arm.
picks_why.C6@ch10_20: C6 is NF-7 (height when no HT value); (1)(B) is the no-numerical-value default. (1)(C)(ii) is the houseplex arm (C76).

proposed_refs.citation: Zoning By-law 569-2013, 40.5.1.10(3)(B) and (4) (Commercial Residential Development Standard Set symbol)
Zoning By-law 569-2013, 40.10.1.10(2) (CR zone Development Standard Sets SS1-SS5)
City of Toronto Open Data, Zoning By-law dataset, Zoning_readme.txt (field STAND_SET)

relocate_why.H19@ch10_40: Spec 67 cites 10.40.20.20(1) (Permitted Uses with Conditions); the quoted building-type list is 10.40.20.40(1) (Permitted Residential Building Types) on the pinned page.
relocate_why.H20@ch10_60: Spec 67 cites 10.60.20.20(1); the quoted building-type list is 10.60.20.40(1) on the pinned page.

C4@10.20.40.70.why: "(Deleted by By-law 648-2025)" is not in 10.20.40.70 on the pinned page nor on the legacy 2026-09-29 page; the legacy check matched it in 10.20.20.40 (building types). The NF-3 claim is the RT clause 10.60.40.70(3)(B)(v).

C4@10.40.40.70.why: As C4@10.20.40.70: not in 10.40.40.70 on either page; the legacy match was 10.40.20.40(1)(E) (building types).
